gloss: to ignore one's own faults (while criticizing others)

definitions.gloss: to ignore one's own faults (while criticizing others); to conveniently overlook
definitions.explanation: To put one's own shortcomings aside, as if placing them up on a shelf out of sight, while blaming or criticizing someone else for the same thing.

examples.japanese: ⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧こと⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{棚|たな}に{上|あ}げる。
⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{遅刻|ちこく}→遅刻：03465_chikoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{棚|たな}に{上|あ}げて⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{責|せ}める→責める：02284_semeru⟧。
examples.english: He blames others while ignoring his own lateness.

examples.japanese: ⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧こと⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{棚|たな}に{上|あ}げて⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧⟦けど→けど：09477_kedo⟧、⟦もう→もう：00602_mou⟧⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧⟦{早|はや}く→早い：00514_hayai⟧⟦{起|お}きた→起きる：00521_okiru⟧⟦ほうがいい→ほうがいい：10078_hougaii⟧⟦よ→よ：09475_yo⟧。
examples.english: I know I'm one to talk, but you'd better get up a little earlier.

notes:
Almost always in the pattern ⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧こと⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧/⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{棚|たな}に{上|あ}げて (ignoring one's own faults). Speakers also use it about themselves as a modest disclaimer before criticizing: ⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧こと⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{棚|たな}に{上|あ}げて⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧ (I know I'm one to talk, but…).
